content: Dule-irwa-Babse-goled-Joiada, birgagugledgi (7), sorda-dulataled-dummaganse (100) gochad.

We-dummagan Levita-dulemar-Judá-yargi-bela-neggweburmargi-gudidimalad Jerusalén-neggweburse-dagmalaga oambikusad. Degi, bela Israel-dulemar-neguya-dummagan Jerusalén-neggweburse-dagmalaga oambikusbalid.

Agine, bela-dulemar Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-bukwad, reybo igar mesismalad. Degi, Joiada amarga sogded: “Wegi rey-machi dukusiid. Ar we, reyga megergebed. Ar igi Bab-Jehová David-wagangi sogsagusa, deyobi guergebed.
Degisoggu, weyob be imakmalo:

content.text: dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad, degi, Levita-dulemar, obunnoged-ibagi-arbamaloedi, Babse-goled-neg-yawagakgi nakulemaloed.

content: ”Unnila, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormaladbi, degi, Levita-dulemar-arbamaladbi, Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-negyaba dogmaloed. Ar wemardi nugsalearmaladid. Dule-baid wargwensaar dogosulid. Dulemardina, Bab-Jehová-Igar-Uksadbali ibsamalagargebed.
Degi, Levita-dulemar, gingimar gani-gani rey-ebilis bela ambikumaloed. Ar dule Bab-Dummadse-goled-negyaba-dogsale, oburgwemalo. Melle reybi wargwengi be obemalo. Bia rey-nadele, eba be namarmogoed.”

Geb degine, Levita-dulemar, degi, bela Judá-dulemar dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-Joiada-sogsadba bela ibmar-imaksamalad. Amar egad-egad e-sordagan-urbisad. Sordamar obunnoged-ibagi-arbamaloed, degi, dule-arbaosulidse-bakar, urbisad. Ar adega, dule-irwa-Babse-goled-Joiada sordamarga obunnoged-igar mesissulid.
Dule-irwa-Babse-goled-Joiada, sorda-e-dummaganga sigumar, degi, sigu-abgaed-dummagan uksad. Degine, sigu-abgaed-senigana-Rey-Davidʼgad, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-bukwadi, a dummaganga uksabalid.

Geb degi, Joiada dulemar-bukumaloedgi bela dulemar-nue-urbisad. Dulemar es-suid-gani-gani, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-argan-nuedsik, degi, argan-sapiledsik ambikusad. Bela rey-dikarba, ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila-asabin, degi, neg-siid-asabin ambikusmarbalid.

Degidgine, Joiada, degi, e-machimarmala, rey-machi-Joás neg-abarse onosmalad, ega rey-gurgin sisad, degi, Bab-Dummad-Israel-dulemarbo-Igar-Maidba-eba-narmakaled ega uksamarbalid. Geb degine, reyga-guega ega rey-gan uklesad. Agine, Joiada e-machimalabo Joás-nonogi gwallu-wawa eosmargu, sogdemalad: “¡Rey, bitigi, be undarsaar megisana gadin!”
Atalía, dulemar-ber-oimake itoargu, degi, dulemar binnasuli-rey-onugsananai-itoargu, Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-negse, dulemar-bukwadse nonikid.

Agine, Atalía, rey dogedgi buar-naba-gwichi daksad. Dummagan, degine, dule-gar-suid-trompeta-ogormalad rey-naba-bukwa daksabalid. Deginbali, Atalía bela-dulemar ber weligwale gar-suid-trompeta ogorbukwa, degi, dule-namakmalad garmar-abargi namakbukwa daksabalid. Atalía deyob daksagua, e-mor siir-siir imaksad, binnasur sogded: “¡Angi be aibichamala! ¡Angi be aibichamala!”

Degi, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-Joiada, Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neggi dule-oburgwileged abesursoggu, sorda-e-dummaganga igar-ukded: “Be ainimar. Atalía Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi dulemar-abargi-gwichid be onomar. Ar dule Atalía-bendakalile, es-suidgi oburgwilegoed.”
Degisoggu, buladik Atalía-gasmarsundo. Geb reyneggi, sordamar-moligi-sii-urwemalad-ubogedsik sesmalad. Agi, Atalía-oburgwismalad.
Degidgine, Joiada bela dulemarbo, degi, reybo igar-mesisad, emarde Bab-Jehová-e-dulemarga gumaloye.

Geb a-sorbali, bela-dulemar bab-Baalʼse-goled-negse nadmalad. Agine, Baal-neg-siid earismalad. Degine, Baalʼga ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila osulosmarbalid, ibmar-e-bab-dummadga-imaklemalad, bela bibichismarbalid. Deginbali, Baalʼga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila-siid-walik, dule-irwa-Baalʼse-goled-Matán oburgwismarbalid.

Geb sorba, Joiada, suar-ibgan Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neggi-nakulegega urbisad. Geb degi, Joiada dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormaladga, degi, Levita-dulemarga-sogsad, be wemar-dakoye. Ar ade, David epenne, we-dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormaladga, degi, Levita-dulemarga igar uksad. Adi, Moisés-Igar-Maidba ibmar-durgan ogumakar Bab-Jehováʼga ukega, degi, na muchub-muchub Bab-Jehováʼga ibmar-imakmalaga, degi, David-igar-mesisadyobi weligwaledbali namakmarbaligar.
Deginbali, Joiada dule-Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neg-yawagak-dakmalad urbisbalid, adi, dule-swilidiksurmalad mer dogegar.
Dummagan reyneg-e-yawagak-dummad-gwichid-innik-gusgua, rey-gangi Rey-Joás-osismalad.
Degine, Atalía es-suidgi-oburgwilesad-sorba, bela dulemar weligwar-itosmalad. Degi, neggweburgi neg bogimakar nagusad.
